### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A02 ran about once per case and appeared in about 49 of 100 traces (97 of 200); in the later window, A02 appears in 0 of 200 traces and no outgoing transitions from it are observed. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- A03 and A14, which previously co-occurred with A02 in about 49 of 100 traces, now appear in only about 19 of 100 traces (37 of 200), with about 0.36 occurrences per case instead of 0.87, and they sit later in the case when they do run (A03 median position 0.36 → 0.55; A14 0.44 → 0.63). [OCC002, OCC003, POS002, POS005]
- Every observed partnership of A02 collapsed: A02 co-occurred with A03, A07, A09, A13 and A14 in about 47–49 of 100 traces before, and with A08, A10, A11 and A15 in about 13–24; in the later window all of these co-occurrences are 0, while the partners continue without A02 (e.g., A13 without A02 in 46 of 100 traces, A09 without A02 in 45 of 100). [REL001, REL002, REL004, REL007, REL008, REL003, REL005, REL006, REL009]
- Successors were rerouted: in the later window, A13 leads to A09 (30%), A08 (28%) and A10 (20%) instead of A02 (34%) and A03 (19%); A09 leads to A10 (47%) instead of A03 (35%) and A14 (25%); A06 leads to A10 (43%) instead of A03 (47%); A15 leads to A10 (63%) instead of A03 (60%); A14 leads to A13 (76%) instead of A07 (33%); A08 leads to A03 (69%) instead of A10 (81%). [DIR009, DIR006, DIR004, DIR011, DIR010, DIR005]
- A10 grew and moved earlier: participation rose from about 24 to 46 of 100 traces, its mean position moved from 0.52 to 0.36, and it now co-occurs with A09, A07 and A13 in about 45 of 100 traces (previously 23–24). [POS003, REL021, REL017, REL023]
- Several pairwise distances were redistributed, e.g., A13 was followed immediately by A03 in 38% of observations before and never after, and A03 is followed by A09 at a distance of 3 steps in 79% of later observations (was 16%). [LAG009, LAG002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the branch containing A02 — which ran together with A03 and A14 in about 49 of 100 earlier traces — was removed from execution, and that its surrounding flows were rerouted: A02 is no longer observed in any of 200 later traces, A03 and A14 now run in only about 19 of 100 traces and later in the case, and transitions that previously fed A02 or A03 now continue to A10, A09, A08 and A13, with A10 executed in about 46 of 100 traces (up from 24) and earlier in the case. [OCC001, DIR001, OCC002, OCC003, POS002, POS005, DIR009, DIR006, DIR004, DIR011, DIR010, DIR005, POS003, REL021]

Supporting signs: the disappearance is shown directly by participation, position and successor profiles (97 of 200 traces and 202 observed outgoing transitions before, none after); the co-occurrence with A02 drops to zero for all nine partner activities while those partners continue without it; and six source activities consistently redirect away from A02/A03. The screening produced 60 qualifying items against fewer than 1 expected without change, so sampling alone cannot explain the pattern as a whole. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, REL001, REL004, REL007, REL002, REL008, REL003, REL005, REL006, REL009, DIR009, DIR006, DIR004, DIR011, DIR010, DIR005]

Limitations and competing explanation: zero participation only means A02 was not observed — it may still execute at a rate too low to appear in 200 traces — and the evidence cannot rule out that part of the successor redistribution reflects sampling variation rather than deliberate rerouting; the many pairs involving A02 also describe the same traces and are not independent confirmations. [OCC001]

Other differences: A10 now repeats itself more often and at more varied distances (typically 4 steps apart before, spread over 3–5 later) [LAG007]; several distance profiles shifted without an obvious tie to the removal, such as shorter A13→A11 and longer A14→A07 distances [LAG011, LAG013]; A11 runs slightly earlier in the case [POS004].

Screening: 134 units tested, 60 items qualified, 0.67 expected by chance without change. 60 items is roughly 90 times the chance expectation. All evidence items are control-flow family (OCC, POS, DIR, REL, LAG). No TWAIT, no ASSIGN/CONC/HAND items. So no time or resource discussion.

Now let me identify the main behavioural differences.

Key observation: A02 disappears completely in the later window:
- OCC001: A02 mean occurrences per trace 1.01 → 0.0, trace participation 0.485 → 0.0 (97 traces before, 0 after). A02 was in about 49 in 100 traces before, about 1 occurrence per trace, and not observed at all after.
- DIR001: outgoing transitions of A02: before had 10 successors (A13 0.42, A08 0.17, A09 0.15, etc.), after empty. Support 202 → 0.
- POS001: A02 position support 0.485 → 0.0.
- REL items with A02: REL008 (A02,A14), REL009 (A02,A15), REL004 (A02,A09), REL002 (A02,A07), REL005 (A02,A10), REL007 (A02,A13), REL006 (A02,A11), REL003 (A02,A08), REL001 (A02,A03) — all show cooccurrence dropping to 0 and B_only rising. E.g., REL004: cooccurrence 0.465 → 0, B_only (A09 only) 0 → 0.45. So A09 now occurs without A02 in about 45 in 100 traces.

So A02 was removed from the process (or at least no longer observed). Before, A02 co-occurred with A03, A07, A08, A09, A10, A11, A13, A14, A15 in about 47-49 in 100 traces (cooccurrence 0.465-0.485). After, A02 is absent and those activities occur without it.

Also A03 and A14 participation dropped:
- OCC002: A03 mean occurrences 0.87 → 0.36, participation 0.485 → 0.185 (97 → 37 traces).
- OCC003: A14 same: 0.87 → 0.36, participation 0.485 → 0.185.
- POS002: A03 support 0.485 → 0.185, mean position 0.374 → 0.51 (later position).
- POS005: A14 support 0.485 → 0.185, mean position 0.485 → 0.609 (later position).

Interesting: A03, A14, and A02 all had participation 0.485 before. And "neither" was 0.515 in all REL items before. This suggests a group of traces (about 49 in 100) contained A02, A03, A14 together. After, that whole branch is gone: A02 gone entirely, A03 and A14 down to about 19 in 100.

Wait — A03 and A14 still appear at 0.185 participation. Hmm, and B_only for A14 in REL008 is 0.185. So A14 appears in about 19 in 100 traces after, without A02.

- DIR005 (A08): before, A08 → A10 in 81% of outgoing transitions; after, A08 → A03 in 69%. Big rerouting.
- DIR011 (A15): before A15 → A03 in 60%; after A15 → A10 in 63%.
- DIR010 (A14): before A14 → A07 33%, A11 20%, A09 8%...; after A14 → A13 in 76%.
- DIR009 (A13): before A13 → A02 34%, A03 19%; after A13 → A09 30%, A08 28%, A10 20%.
- DIR006 (A09): before A09 → A03 35%, A14 25%; after A09 → A10 47%.
- DIR007 (A10): before A10 → A02 37%, A13 37%; after A10 → A07 33%, A11 25%, A13 14%.
- DIR004 (A06): before A06 → A03 47%, A11 29%; after A06 → A10 43%.
- DIR008 (A11): before A11 → A03 27%, A15 30%; after A11 → A15 32%, A10 22%, A06 22%.
- DIR003 (A05): before A05 → A02 27%, A13 29%, A08 32%; after A05 → A13 34%, A03 16%, A14 16%, A09 16%.

So the picture: A02 disappeared; A03 and A14 became much rarer; successors that previously led to A02/A03 now lead to A10, A09, A08, A13, A07 etc.

LAG changes: distances redistributed. E.g., LAG009 (A13→A03): before 38% at distance 1; after 0% at distance 1. LAG015 (A14→A13): all distance components decreased (support dropped). LAG002 (A03→A09): before spread over 1-2; after 79% at distance 3.
